Synthetic example dendrometer dataset

Source: R/data.R
dendro_sample.Rd

Two fully synthetic hourly stem-dendrometer series spanning two growing seasons (April 2021 to November 2022, UTC), for examples and vignettes. SYN_Fs001 is a clean series (seasonal growth, diel shrink-recover cycle, winter shrinkage). SYN_Pa002 additionally carries a +35 micrometre sensor-reinstallation step on 2022-06-15 and a four-day data gap in August 2021 – the two artefacts dm_clean_series() exists to fix.

Usage

dendro_sample

Format

A data.frame with 29,232 rows and 3 columns:

series

character, series identifier (SITE_SpAb### style).

ts

POSIXct timestamp, UTC, hourly.

value

numeric, stem radius reading in micrometres.

Source

Synthetic; generated by data-raw/dendro_sample.R (seed 421).
